admission.justification: Spans the settings reference and its readers: retaining every accepted key with a stated reader/enforcer or no-reader boundary is how FAM-GDXSJG keeps the reference an honest map through behavior changes.

applicability: The shipped settings reference and the onboarding path for provider, mode and feature choices.
conditions: Every accepted key states its reader/enforcer or its explicit no-reader boundary.
Onboarding reads choices from the existing public options catalog with the host running.
exclusions: qualityGate, concurrency, spawn and loops keys presented as enforced.
statement: The reference retains every accepted settings key and states its reader/enforcer or no-reader boundary. Onboarding obtains provider/mode/feature choices from the existing public options catalog with the host running.
